CYP2C9 is one of the key pharmacogenes involved in implementation of pharmacogenomics.

  • It is involved in guidelines for warfarin, phenytoin and NSAIDs, (go to list of all guidelines with CYP2C9).
  • the nomenclature has been set by PharmVar
  • the AMP tier 1 alleles are CYP2C9*2, CYP2C9*3, CYP2C9*5, CYP2C9*6, CYP2C9*8, and CYP2C9*11, see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list
  • key variant pages include rs1799853 and rs1057910
  • See the Gene-specific Information Tables for Allele Definitions (for which variants comprise which star alleles), Allele function assignments (normal function, no function, decreased or increased function etc) and Diplotype-Phenotype Table (for how the alleles combine to form metabolizer phenotypes for PM, NM, UM)
